description: One signature, computed by the SERVER's own signer, not by this package. Three implementations are locked to it: the server that mints the header, this Python client, and the TypeScript client. Any one of them drifting fails against a vector none of them produced.
recipe: v1 = HMAC-SHA256(key=secret, message="<timestamp>.<body>") in lowercase hex; header = "t=<timestamp>" followed by one "v1=<hex>" per signing secret, newest first.
